outcome_label: Completed under high pressure — intervention helped
outcome_detail: This high-pressure time-limited environment run (tension team) reached 100% completion in 18 steps. Stress ran high with little to no conflict. Agents exchanged 4 pieces of information. Outcome: Completed under high pressure — intervention helped. The elevated stress came from scenario pressure and blocker ageing rather than interpersonal conflict — cooperation remained dominant throughout. This matches the Tension Team preset. Stress rose while the active blocker remained unresolved, and challenge events showed friction under pressure, but cooperation still outweighed conflict. Interventions used: reveal_info, reveal_info, inject_tension.

events.text: We still need the map to complete this. Do you have it?
Not yet — I still have doubts about the map.
It fits, but — one more pass on the map?
Back to the map — here's my read — check it: the room splits into three sections, hidden panel east side.
Yeah... okay. Hold onto that.
I'll say it, but I'm not fully sold: it's triangle → circle → square, in that order.
I've got the key piece lined up. Finish pattern and I'll use it.
We don't have time to hesitate.
I'll take it. That holds up.
Code Breaker, the key — I need it now.
We can't move without the key.
Every minute we hesitate we're worse off.
Can we piece the clues together carefully?
I think saying it before I lose my nerve: under the loose tile by the door.
Okay, I've got door code. Let's use it.
I want the code checked properly. What have you got?
Right. Door Code is solid. Move.
Here: four, two, seven, one.
I'll take it. That holds up.
Hold on — verify the code once. 4-2-7-1 — say it back so we know we're aligned.
4-2-7-1. That matches what I've got. Clear to enter.
Entering 4-2-7-1. If this is wrong, we're back to square one.
Exit Lock is starting to feel shaky.
